notes.obo: OBO PURL base — class IRIs are obo:{ONTOLOGY}_{ID} (e.g., obo:BFO_0000001)
notes.RO: OBO Relation Ontology — standard cross-ontology relations
notes.IAO: Information Artifact Ontology — metadata properties (definitions, deprecation)
notes.oio: OBO in OWL annotations — synonyms, xrefs, subsets
notes.sssom: Simple Standard for Sharing Ontological Mappings
notes.semapv: Semantic Mapping Vocabulary — mapping justification terms
notes.here: In this repository read project-profile.md first. BFO, RO, OBI and oio are not used here (decision 4); they stay for upstream comparison. IAO's deprecation properties (IAO_0100001, IAO_0000231) are one of the options for a deprecated term's replacement annotation, beside dcterms:isReplacedBy; that choice is Benjamin's and open.
notes.gist: gist (Semantic Arts), the upper ontology here as a small projection. Checked in gist 14.1.0 ontologies/gistCore.ttl, 2026-11-22.
notes.iof-core: Industrial Ontologies Foundry core; an alignment only (decision 4). The owl:Ontology IRI of the core module, read 2026-11-22 (versionIRI .../ontology/202603/core/Core/).
notes.org: W3C Organization Ontology; alignment only. Checked against org.ttl, 2026-11-22.
notes.fibo: FIBO has no single namespace: each module has its own, under this root. fibo-fnd-org-fm is the FormalOrganizations module, read 2026-11-22; add other modules by the prefix FIBO itself declares. Alignment only.
notes.epcis: GS1 EPCIS 2.0; epcis, cbv and gs1 as declared in https://ref.gs1.org/standards/epcis/epcis-context.jsonld, read 2026-11-22. Alignment only.
notes.qudt: QUDT schema, units and quantity kinds, each checked against its Turtle, 2026-11-22. Alignment for units of measure.
notes.schema: schema.org publishes both http://schema.org/ and https://schema.org/ files; decision 30 chose https and this entry follows it. Alignment only.
notes.inv: This repository's own terms. A placeholder under example.org (decision 7) for examples only: the exact IRI is not decided and is written once, in the vocabulary module (not built), which wins over this entry. Never mint an IRI under Sutton's name, a customer's subdomain or any real domain.
notes.isa95: ISA-95 has no prefix here: no RDF namespace for it is recorded. Its alignment rows cite the standard's term name.
notes.sutton: Sutton publishes no RDF namespace, and decision 7 forbids minting one under its name, so there is no sutton prefix. How an alignment row cites a Sutton term (its term name, as report 02's sutton:Account sketch does informally) is open, for Benjamin.
